pictures.description: A girl and a kite high in the sky.
pictures.text: Nia took her kite to the park. A puff of wind lifted it high.

pictures.description: The kite beside the top of a tree.
pictures.text: The wind pushed the kite into a tree, and its string went slack.

pictures.description: A grown-up beside the girl and the tree.
pictures.text: Nia called Dad over. Together they looked for a low branch.

pictures.description: Dad beside the tree and the kite out of the leaves.
pictures.text: Dad lifted the loose string off a low twig. Down came the kite.

pictures.description: The kite on the grass beside Nia and Dad.
pictures.text: Nia untangled its tail on the grass. “Let's try the big field,” she said.

pictures.description: The kite up in the open sky again.
pictures.text: They moved away from the trees. This time the kite had the whole sky to dance in.

pictures.description: A boy beside a bean and an empty cup.
pictures.text: Sami found a bean and a paper cup. He wondered what the bean might become.

pictures.description: A bean next to a little pot of soil.
pictures.text: He put soil in the cup, tucked in the bean, and patted the soil flat.

pictures.description: A drop of water above the pot.
pictures.text: He gave the bean a little drink and put it where the light could reach it.

pictures.description: A tiny green shoot in the light.
pictures.text: A few days later, Sami spotted a green hook poking out of the soil.

pictures.description: A taller plant with a ruler beside it.
pictures.text: Two leaves opened. Sami held up a ruler to see how much the plant had grown.

pictures.description: Two children beside a leafy plant.
pictures.text: His sister came to look. “Next time let's plant two,” said Sami.

pictures.description: A girl with boots and rain at the window.
pictures.text: Bea heard rain patter at the window. She pulled on her boots.

pictures.description: A girl under an umbrella near a puddle.
pictures.text: Outside, an umbrella kept Bea dry all the way to the gate.

pictures.description: Water splashing up near a boot.
pictures.text: At the first puddle she tried a little stomp. Splash!

pictures.description: Two children on either side of a splash.
pictures.text: Her brother tried two little stomps. His splash was wide enough to make them both laugh.

pictures.description: Two children beside a puddle under a rainbow.
pictures.text: The rain slowed. They stopped stomping when they spotted colours across the sky.

pictures.description: Two children with boots off and dry socks nearby.
pictures.text: Home again, they left their wet boots by the door and wriggled into dry socks.

pictures.description: A child with a teddy bear near a bed.
pictures.text: Leo brought Teddy to bed every night. That morning he carried Teddy out to play.

pictures.description: A child beside a bed with an empty space.
pictures.text: At bedtime, Teddy wasn't on the pillow. Leo checked under the blanket.

pictures.description: A sock near a sofa and a boy looking nearby.
pictures.text: He looked under the sofa and found a sock. The sock did not look cuddly.

pictures.description: A boy beside a basket and an apple.
pictures.text: He looked in the kitchen basket. There was an apple, but no Teddy.

pictures.description: A teddy bear peeking out above a box.
pictures.text: Then Leo remembered their box train. Teddy was still riding inside the last carriage.

pictures.description: A boy and a teddy bear beside a bed.
pictures.text: Leo tucked Teddy under his arm. “Next stop, bed,” he whispered.

pictures.description: A big duck and ducklings on the water.
pictures.text: Mother Duck led her little ones to the edge of the pond.

pictures.description: Ducks on the shore beside a rock.
pictures.text: She climbed onto a flat rock. The ducklings scrambled after her.

pictures.description: A child watches ducks go by.
pictures.text: On the path, Mina stopped and waited while the ducks waddled across.

pictures.description: One duckling behind the others by some leaves.
pictures.text: The smallest duckling paused beside a leaf. Mother Duck called out.

pictures.description: A duckling splashing by the others.
pictures.text: The little duck hurried to catch up and hopped straight into the water.

pictures.description: A big duck with ducklings around her on the pond.
pictures.text: Mina watched the whole family paddle away. This time the smallest duck swam in front.

pictures.description: A child with a sheet of paper and a crayon.
pictures.text: Jo drew a blue stripe on a piece of paper.

pictures.description: A child with a small boat and a piece of paper.
pictures.text: With Mum's help, she folded the paper into a little boat.

pictures.description: A child next to a boat at the water's edge.
pictures.text: Jo set the boat on a shallow puddle and gave it a tiny push.

pictures.description: A boat on water near some leaves.
pictures.text: A breeze sailed it across until its nose caught in a leaf.

pictures.description: A child with a leaf beside the boat.
pictures.text: Jo nudged the leaf aside with a stick. The boat was free again.

pictures.description: A boat by the window with water drops.
pictures.text: She put her soggy boat on the windowsill to dry. Its blue stripe was still there.

pictures.description: Two children with one apple between them.
pictures.text: Ishaan and Tara reached for the same shiny apple.

pictures.description: The children beside the apple with a question mark above.
pictures.text: There was only one. Tara wondered how they could both have some.

pictures.description: A grown-up between the children with the apple below.
pictures.text: They asked Grandpa to cut it into two pieces.

pictures.description: Each child has a piece of apple.
pictures.text: Grandpa put a piece in front of each child. Ishaan's piece was a little bigger.

pictures.description: The children with a plate and a bit of apple in between.
pictures.text: Ishaan broke off a little from his piece and put it on Tara's plate.

pictures.description: Two children and an empty plate.
pictures.text: They crunched until the plate was empty. “Next time, pear?” asked Tara.

pictures.description: Two children with a big cardboard box.
pictures.text: Kit and Ada found a big empty box. Ada tapped it like a drum.

pictures.description: The children, a box, and a crayon on the rug.
pictures.text: Kit drew round wheels on the side. Now the box looked like a train.

pictures.description: A teddy waiting in front of a cardboard box.
pictures.text: Ada gave Teddy the first seat. A rabbit toy waited next to him.

pictures.description: Two toys by the box and a train above.
pictures.text: The toys took turns riding as the children called out station names.

pictures.description: Two children making music next to a box.
pictures.text: One corner of the box bent. Kit made a brake noise and pulled into the repair station.

pictures.description: A sofa with a box and a teddy nearby.
pictures.text: They made the sofa the next train. The cardboard box became the station.

pictures.description: A girl watches a bird by a tree.
pictures.text: Zahra spotted a little bird hopping around under the tree.

pictures.description: A child beside a pile of seed and a grown-up.
pictures.text: Her aunt brought bird seed and helped her fill a feeder.

pictures.description: A tree with a nest shape above and seeds below.
pictures.text: They hung the feeder from a branch and went inside to give the birds space.

pictures.description: A child at a window with a bird nearby.
pictures.text: For a while nothing happened. Then a small bird landed by the window.

pictures.description: Two birds around some seed.
pictures.text: One bird took a seed. Another swept down for its turn.

pictures.description: A child, an open notebook, a crayon, and a bird beyond.
pictures.text: Zahra drew two birds in her notebook. She left room for more visitors.

pictures.description: A child outdoors with mittens and a snowflake.
pictures.text: Mai put on her mittens and stepped into the fresh snow.

pictures.description: A girl near a big snowball and a smaller one.
pictures.text: She packed a little snowball, then rolled it until it was too big to lift.

pictures.description: Two children beside a snow person.
pictures.text: Her brother lifted a smaller ball onto it. The snow friend had a head.

pictures.description: The snow person next to a scarf and a carrot.
pictures.text: Mai found a carrot nose. Her brother offered his spare scarf.

pictures.description: Two children beside the snow person in sunshine.
pictures.text: They waved goodbye as sunshine warmed the garden.

pictures.description: A girl beside a puddle, a scarf, and a carrot.
pictures.text: The next day, the snow friend was a puddle. Mai saved the scarf for the next snow.

pictures.description: Two children with blocks between them.
pictures.text: Mo and Lina decided to build a tower taller than a cushion.

pictures.description: Blocks stacked high between the children.
pictures.text: They put one narrow block underneath and piled two on top.

pictures.description: Blocks spread across the floor by the children's feet.
pictures.text: The tower rocked once, then fell. The blocks made a big clack.

pictures.description: A wide row of blocks with one above it.
pictures.text: Lina laid three blocks side by side. Mo put the next one in the middle.

pictures.description: A stack of blocks with a wider bottom.
pictures.text: Their new tower reached the top of the cushion. It stayed still when they let go.

pictures.description: A little flag above the tower.
pictures.text: Mo added a paper flag. Lina named it the Wobbly Tower, even though it stayed up.

pictures.description: Two snails with a leaf ahead of them.
pictures.text: Pip and Dot, two snails, both spotted the same juicy leaf.

pictures.description: A stone between two snails.
pictures.text: Pip tried to go straight over a pebble. Dot went around.

pictures.description: One snail on the pebble, with the leaf in view.
pictures.text: From the top Pip could see the leaf, but getting down took just as long as getting up.

pictures.description: Both snails close to the same leaf.
pictures.text: Dot was almost there when Pip reached the bottom. They met at the edge of the leaf.

pictures.description: The snails on either side of the leaf.
pictures.text: Dot nibbled one end. Pip nibbled the other.

pictures.description: The two snails close together in the sunshine.
pictures.text: By the time they stopped to rest, neither snail remembered who won.

pictures.description: A child with a bucket by the waves.
pictures.text: Pia took an empty bucket down to the beach.

pictures.description: A shell between Pia and her bucket.
pictures.text: She found a shell with ridges like little steps.

pictures.description: A shell and a smooth stone near the bucket.
pictures.text: Next she found a smooth stone that shone when the water touched it.

pictures.description: A crab next to a shell.
pictures.text: Something moved beside another shell. Pia backed up and watched a crab walk away.

pictures.description: Shells and a stone in a line on the sand.
pictures.text: She laid her finds in a line, from the smoothest to the bumpiest.

pictures.description: Pia with an empty bucket and a shell on the sand.
pictures.text: Pia left her line for someone else to find. The bucket went home full of fresh air.

pictures.description: A child with a bag by a bus stop.
pictures.text: Ben waited at the bus stop with an empty book bag.

pictures.description: A bus arrives at the stop.
pictures.text: The bus pulled up. Ben and his uncle climbed on.

pictures.description: A bus passing trees on its way toward a building.
pictures.text: Through the window Ben watched trees slide by, then saw the library ahead.

pictures.description: A child and a grown-up beside books.
pictures.text: He carried a dinosaur book and a rhyming book to the desk.

pictures.description: A child beside the bus with a book bag.
pictures.text: On the way home the bag sat heavy on his lap.

pictures.description: A child and a grown-up with an open book and a dinosaur above.
pictures.text: Ben opened the dinosaur book first. His uncle made the biggest dinosaur roar very softly.

pictures.description: A fox with berries near some leaves.
pictures.text: Fox found a patch of blueberries and stopped for a snack.

pictures.description: Fox and Bear meet beside the berries.
pictures.text: Bear arrived with a very empty tummy. Fox paused with a berry in her mouth.

pictures.description: Berries spread out between Fox and Bear.
pictures.text: Fox nudged half the pile towards Bear. They ate in the shade.

pictures.description: Rain falls above Fox and Bear.
pictures.text: A sudden shower sent cold drops down Bear's nose.

pictures.description: Fox and Bear beside a large green leaf.
pictures.text: Bear held a big leaf over them while they waited for the rain to pass.

pictures.description: Fox and Bear under a rainbow with berries nearby.
pictures.text: They split the last berry. It was smaller than a paw and sweet enough for two.

pictures.description: A girl and a shoe near a bus stop.
pictures.text: Inez tapped one shoe while she waited for the bus.

pictures.description: Two children with a musical note above them.
pictures.text: Her brother heard the tapping and clapped between taps.

pictures.description: Clapping hands above a shoe between the children.
pictures.text: They made a pattern: tap, clap, tap, clap.

pictures.description: A grown-up between the children under music notes.
pictures.text: A neighbour joined in with a quiet hum.

pictures.description: A bus and the two children.
pictures.text: The bus arrived just in time for their last clap.

pictures.description: The bus leaves the stop with music notes above.
pictures.text: As they rode away, Inez kept the beat with one finger on her knee.

pictures.description: A child beside a basket, banana, and sandwich.
pictures.text: Asha packed a banana and sandwiches for a picnic.

pictures.description: A grown-up and child with a basket and blanket.
pictures.text: They spread a yellow blanket where the grass was dry.

pictures.description: A dog waits at the edge of the picnic.
pictures.text: A dog sat nearby and watched them open their lunch.

pictures.description: The picnic with a leaf blowing overhead.
pictures.text: A gust lifted a corner of the blanket. Asha put the basket on it.

pictures.description: The dog beside a treat near the basket.
pictures.text: Mum fetched the dog's own snack from a pocket in the basket.

pictures.description: The family beside a packed basket in sunshine.
pictures.text: After all three had eaten, they packed up and walked home together.

pictures.description: A child, a bicycle, and a grown-up.
pictures.text: Liv wanted a bell for her bike so friends could hear her coming.

pictures.description: A bell and tool between Liv and a grown-up.
pictures.text: Dad found a bell in a box. Liv held it while he got the right tool.

pictures.description: A bell above a bicycle beside Liv and Dad.
pictures.text: They fixed the bell to the handlebar. Liv tried it once indoors.

pictures.description: Liv and a bicycle near a boy with a sound mark above.
pictures.text: Outside, she rang as she rolled slowly up to her brother.

pictures.description: A boy waving beside Liv and her bicycle.
pictures.text: He turned at the sound and waved. Liv stopped so he could cross.

pictures.description: Liv back with Dad and the bicycle bell.
pictures.text: On the way home she rang for Dad. He answered with a cheerful “ding!”

pictures.description: A child with a plain shirt and a crayon.
pictures.text: Sol found an old plain shirt and asked if he could give it new colours.

pictures.description: A child beside paper, a crayon, and a rainbow.
pictures.text: He drew a rainbow plan on paper before touching the shirt.

pictures.description: A child and a grown-up with a shirt and paint.
pictures.text: Auntie helped him spread the shirt flat and brought out fabric paint.

pictures.description: A painted red mark above Sol, his shirt, and paints.
pictures.text: The brush made a red drip. Sol made it the first of three little drops under the rainbow.

pictures.description: A shirt drying outdoors with its rainbow above.
pictures.text: They left the shirt to dry. Sol checked it every time he went past.

pictures.description: Sol shows a rainbow shirt to another child.
pictures.text: That afternoon he showed his cousin the rainbow. The three drops were his favourite part.

pictures.description: A girl at a window with a moon outside.
pictures.text: The moon was in Hana's kitchen window while she had a drink.

pictures.description: Hana with a toothbrush by another window.
pictures.text: She saw it from the bathroom too, just above the next roof.

pictures.description: Hana beside her bed with the moon still in view.
pictures.text: “Is the moon following me?” she asked when she saw it from bed.

pictures.description: Hana and a grown-up under the moon.
pictures.text: Mum took her outside. They walked to the far side of the garden together.

pictures.description: Hana and Mum with the house between them and the moon above.
pictures.text: Different fence posts went by, but the faraway moon hardly seemed to move.

pictures.description: A girl beside a bed with a book and the moon nearby.
pictures.text: Back in bed, Hana said goodnight to the moon. It could stay up as long as it liked.

pictures.description: A mouse with thread and a large button.
pictures.text: Mouse found a wide button under the sewing basket.

pictures.description: Mouse places a button beside the water.
pictures.text: At a puddle, he set it down and pretended it was a boat.

pictures.description: A mouse, a button, and a floating leaf.
pictures.text: The button sank. A leaf drifted past without sinking.

pictures.description: Mouse beside a leaf and a small stick.
pictures.text: Mouse laid a twig on the leaf and set it afloat.

pictures.description: A ladybird and a floating leaf near Mouse.
pictures.text: Ladybird stepped aboard, and the leaf carried her to the other side.

pictures.description: Mouse and Ladybird on the sunny shore.
pictures.text: Ladybird waved. “Tomorrow,” called Mouse, “I'll bring another leaf!”

pictures.description: A child and a grown-up beside a tent.
pictures.text: Esme helped her grandad put up a tent in the garden.

pictures.description: Esme near the tent at night.
pictures.text: When the sky went dark, the inside of the tent went dark too.

pictures.description: A torch on the ground between Esme and Grandad.
pictures.text: Grandad handed Esme a torch. Its beam was just right for finding her shoes.

pictures.description: A torch pointing beside the tent.
pictures.text: Inside, the bright beam made a tiny spot. The corners were still dark.

pictures.description: A glowing lantern between Esme and Grandad.
pictures.text: Grandad switched on a battery lantern. A gentle light reached all the corners.

pictures.description: An open book beside the tent with a lantern above.
pictures.text: They read one page by lantern light. Then Esme heard an owl and closed the book to listen.

pictures.description: A child and a grown-up beside small green leaves.
pictures.text: Ravi and Grandma found carrot tops peeking up from a garden bed.

pictures.description: A carrot comes out of the soil near Ravi.
pictures.text: Ravi pulled gently. The carrot slid out wearing a coat of dirt.

pictures.description: Two carrots close together with a question mark above.
pictures.text: Under the dirt was a surprise. One carrot had grown two long legs.

pictures.description: A child rinses a carrot near a tap.
pictures.text: Grandma helped him wash it. Ravi made the clean carrot take a little walk.

pictures.description: Carrots beside a serving plate.
pictures.text: Grandma cut pieces for lunch. The two-legged carrot tasted just like the straight one.

pictures.description: Ravi draws beside a picture of the carrot.
pictures.text: Ravi drew the carrot in his notebook. In his drawing it wore two tiny boots.

pictures.description: A boy with a mitten and a sled.
pictures.text: Finn wore two red mittens when he took his sled out.

pictures.description: A mitten in the snow close to the sled.
pictures.text: As he pulled the sled, one mitten slipped out of his pocket.

pictures.description: A boy with one mitten beside a scarf indoors.
pictures.text: In the hallway he counted one mitten and one cold hand.

pictures.description: Footprints lead back towards the sled.
pictures.text: Finn followed his own footprints back to the place where he'd stopped.

pictures.description: A mitten on the snow near a snow person.
pictures.text: There it was. The snow person had been guarding it.

pictures.description: Two mittens drying near a mug.
pictures.text: Finn left both mittens to dry by the door and wrapped his hands around a warm mug.

pictures.description: A child and a banana peel beside a bowl.
pictures.text: When Ava finished her banana, she put the peel into a bowl.

pictures.description: A bowl with apple and banana scraps.
pictures.text: She added an apple core. “Is anyone going to eat these?” she asked.

pictures.description: A child and grown-up beside a big garden container.
pictures.text: Grandpa took her out to the compost bin and lifted its lid.

pictures.description: Dry leaves and banana scraps beside the bin.
pictures.text: They tipped in the scraps and tucked them under dry leaves.

pictures.description: A worm near the compost bin.
pictures.text: Much later, Grandpa showed Ava a worm in the dark, crumbly compost.

pictures.description: A pot and compost beside Ava and Grandpa.
pictures.text: They mixed some compost into a flowerpot. The old banana peel had helped make food for a plant.

pictures.description: A child, a laundry basket, and a sock.
pictures.text: Omar helped hang the clean socks outside.

pictures.description: A sock blows up in the wind.
pictures.text: A gust pulled one sock loose and sent it flying.

pictures.description: A sock caught in a tree beside Omar.
pictures.text: The sock landed on a low branch. Omar could see its striped toe.

pictures.description: A grown-up and child with the sock beneath the tree.
pictures.text: Mum reached up and freed it. A leaf had got inside.

pictures.description: Omar beside the recovered sock and basket.
pictures.text: Omar shook out the leaf and used a second peg for the sock.

pictures.description: Two socks in front of a laundry basket.
pictures.text: When the socks were dry, Omar matched the stripes. The pair was together again.

pictures.description: A sheep and a bell with fog nearby.
pictures.text: A lamb named Pebble heard a bell ring across a foggy field.

pictures.description: A lamb under a sound mark in fog.
pictures.text: Pebble took two steps then stopped to listen again.

pictures.description: A little bird near the lamb in the fog.
pictures.text: For a moment all he could hear was a bird in the hedge.

pictures.description: The lamb and a bigger sheep with the bell.
pictures.text: Then the bell rang close by. His mum's nose poked out of the fog.

pictures.description: Two sheep together near a gate.
pictures.text: Pebble walked beside her until they reached the gate.

pictures.description: Both sheep on green grass as the sky clears.
pictures.text: By breakfast the fog was lifting. Now Pebble could see the whole field.

pictures.description: A boy beside a bowl and an egg.
pictures.text: Hugo stirred pancake batter while Dad warmed the pan.

pictures.description: A grown-up beside a pan with batter nearby.
pictures.text: Dad poured a little batter in. It bubbled at the edges.

pictures.description: A pancake above the pan between Hugo and Dad.
pictures.text: Dad flipped it. The pancake landed folded in half.

pictures.description: A pancake, a strawberry, and a plate.
pictures.text: Hugo saw a pocket where Dad saw a pancake. They filled it with sliced strawberries.

pictures.description: A strawberry near the plate between the two cooks.
pictures.text: Hugo took a bite. A berry rolled out the other end.

pictures.description: A new pancake beside a few blueberries.
pictures.text: “Fold the next one too,” said Hugo. “I want to try a blueberry pocket.”

pictures.description: A girl with a banana beside a backpack.
pictures.text: Aya packed a banana for a long walk with Mum.

pictures.description: Aya with her bag beside Mum among trees.
pictures.text: They followed a path through the trees, listening to their footsteps.

pictures.description: A squirrel beside a log near Aya.
pictures.text: A squirrel darted over a log. Aya stopped to see where it went.

pictures.description: Aya and Mum with an open bag and a question mark above.
pictures.text: At snack time Aya looked in the bag. A book was there, but the banana wasn't.

pictures.description: Aya and Mum beside a pear.
pictures.text: Mum gave Aya part of her pear. They shared it on a bench.

pictures.description: A banana waiting near the bag, beside a book.
pictures.text: Back home, the banana was still on the counter. Aya ate it while Mum read the book.

pictures.description: A toy rabbit, a child, and a box.
pictures.text: Rose decided her toy Rabbit needed a little house.

pictures.description: A crayon in front of the box and Rabbit.
pictures.text: Mum helped make a doorway. Rose drew a square window.

pictures.description: Rabbit beside a doorway blocked by a piece of card.
pictures.text: Rabbit's ears caught on the door. The opening was too short.

pictures.description: A grown-up helps Rose with the box while Rabbit waits.
pictures.text: Mum made the doorway taller. Rose tried Rabbit again.

pictures.description: Rabbit peeks up from the box near a little bed.
pictures.text: Rabbit fitted inside, with just enough room for a folded cloth bed.

pictures.description: Rose and Rabbit in the box-house at bedtime.
pictures.text: At bedtime Rose left the door open a crack. Rabbit liked to see the moon.

pictures.description: Two children sit by a drum.
pictures.text: Mal and Jo took turns tapping a little drum.

pictures.description: Both children near the drum with one music note.
pictures.text: Mal tapped twice. Jo tapped twice back.

pictures.description: The children and drum under several music notes.
pictures.text: Jo tried three taps. Mal answered with four by mistake.

pictures.description: Clapping hands above the drum between the children.
pictures.text: They slowed down and clapped the taps before playing them.

pictures.description: The children trade turns on the drum.
pictures.text: This time Mal heard all three taps and played three back.

pictures.description: The children beside the drum with a quiet sign above.
pictures.text: For the last turn, Jo tapped so softly that they both leaned close to hear.

pictures.description: A girl and her boots beside a puddle.
pictures.text: After the rain, Lina found a wide puddle by the step.

pictures.description: A stone marks the edge of the wet patch.
pictures.text: She laid a small stone at the edge so she could find the same spot later.

pictures.description: The puddle and its marker in sunshine.
pictures.text: When the sun came out, Lina checked. The stone was on dry ground.

pictures.description: A smaller wet spot, stone, and ruler near Lina.
pictures.text: The wet patch was smaller than the ruler she brought to measure it.

pictures.description: A dry patch marked with a stone while two people look.
pictures.text: By afternoon it had gone. Dad said some water had warmed up and gone into the air.

pictures.description: Lina with a notebook and a picture of water.
pictures.text: Lina drew a big puddle, a little puddle, and finally just a stone.

pictures.description: A girl near a cap on a windy day.
pictures.text: The wind took Kim's cap right off her head.

pictures.description: A cap on the grass near a squirrel.
pictures.text: It landed near a squirrel. The squirrel stopped with one paw up.

pictures.description: A squirrel pulls at a cap near a tree.
pictures.text: The squirrel tugged the brim. A dry leaf flew out.

pictures.description: A leaf above the squirrel and cap.
pictures.text: The squirrel took the leaf and ran to the tree. Kim waited until it was gone.

pictures.description: Kim picks up her cap beside another leaf.
pictures.text: Kim shook another leaf out of the cap and put it back on.

pictures.description: Kim holds the cap while the squirrel sits by the tree.
pictures.text: She held the brim all the way home. The squirrel could have the leaves.

pictures.description: A child and three books beside a bag.
pictures.text: Eli borrowed three books and carried them to the library door.

pictures.description: A child stands by the books as rain falls outside.
pictures.text: Rain drummed on the pavement. The books couldn't go out like that.

pictures.description: Books and a jacket beside an open bag.
pictures.text: His bag was small. He put the biggest book in first and tried it the other way round.

pictures.description: A grown-up helps Eli with the bag and books.
pictures.text: An older cousin helped him turn the other books sideways. They all fitted.

pictures.description: Eli and his cousin under one umbrella with the bag.
pictures.text: They walked close under one umbrella. Eli held the bag up off the wet ground.

pictures.description: An open book indoors while rain falls outside.
pictures.text: At home the books were dry. They read the one with the biggest pictures first.

pictures.description: A hedgehog near a puddle with an apple on the other side.
pictures.text: Hedgehog saw a fallen apple across a puddle.

pictures.description: A rabbit on the far side of a puddle from Hedgehog.
pictures.text: Rabbit hopped over in one jump. Hedgehog couldn't jump as far.

pictures.description: A branch is lying near the puddle.
pictures.text: Hedgehog found a wide piece of bark and pushed it towards the water.

pictures.description: Hedgehog and Rabbit beside bark across the water.
pictures.text: Rabbit pulled the far end onto dry ground. The bark made a bridge.

pictures.description: Hedgehog on the bridge close to the apple.
pictures.text: Hedgehog walked across, making each step very small.

pictures.description: Hedgehog and Rabbit beside the apple and bridge.
pictures.text: “You can keep the apple,” said Rabbit. “I'll keep the bridge for the next rainy day.”

pictures.description: A girl beside the waves and a shell.
pictures.text: Tilly wanted to show Nan what the sea looked like today.

pictures.description: Tilly with paper, a crayon, and a picture of waves.
pictures.text: She drew waves across a postcard and added one tiny shell.

pictures.description: Tilly and a grown-up beside a card and a pen.
pictures.text: Dad wrote Nan's address while Tilly added a big kiss in the corner.

pictures.description: Tilly holds a card near a postbox.
pictures.text: Tilly pushed the card through the slot and heard it land with a soft flap.

pictures.description: A delivery van carries the post onward.
pictures.text: The post travelled much farther than Tilly could walk.

pictures.description: Nan beside the delivered card and a shell.
pictures.text: Nan put the card on her shelf. Now she had a little piece of the sea, too.

pictures.description: A boy notices a bee around a sunflower.
pictures.text: Theo saw a bee land in the middle of a sunflower.

pictures.description: A child sits back from the sunflower and bee.
pictures.text: He sat back so the bee had room and watched it move from spot to spot.

pictures.description: A bee above two different flowers.
pictures.text: The bee lifted off and stopped at a smaller flower.

pictures.description: A notebook and crayon near the tall flower.
pictures.text: Theo drew both flowers. He put a dot on each place the bee had landed.

pictures.description: A child shows a grown-up the notebook by the flowers.
pictures.text: Mum came to look. Theo traced the bee's path with a finger.

pictures.description: A butterfly near the two flowers.
pictures.text: A butterfly arrived next. Theo turned to a clean page.

title: A New Place for the Pot

pictures.description: A plant sits on one side of a window near a girl.
pictures.text: Noor's little plant always sat on the same side of the window.

pictures.description: The pot sits beside a bright patch of sunlight.
pictures.text: One morning she saw its leaves leaning into the bright patch.

pictures.description: Noor and the pot with a turning arrow.
pictures.text: She turned the pot a little and drew how the leaves looked.

pictures.description: Noor checks the plant using her notebook.
pictures.text: Days later, she held up her picture. The new leaves were reaching towards the light again.

pictures.description: Noor and a grown-up choose where to put the plant.
pictures.text: She and Dad found a spot in the middle of the wide window.

pictures.description: The plant sits beside Noor's updated drawing.
pictures.text: Noor drew the scene once more. This time she remembered to draw the light.

pictures.description: A child, a toy robot, and a cardboard box.
pictures.text: Sam made a finish line from a box for his toy robot.

pictures.description: A forward arrow lies near the robot.
pictures.text: Each arrow card meant one step. Sam laid down a row of cards.

pictures.description: The robot is moving away from the box.
pictures.text: The robot went the wrong way. Sam stopped to check the first card.

pictures.description: A turning arrow lies between Sam and the robot.
pictures.text: He turned the arrow around and asked his sister to try the instructions.

pictures.description: A second child watches the robot reach the box.
pictures.text: This time the robot reached the box. His sister added a little wave at the end.

pictures.description: The toy robot gets ready to go the other way.
pictures.text: Sam put the old arrow down again. Now the robot had instructions to get home.

pictures.description: A girl with a lone sock and laundry basket.
pictures.text: Amara found one sock with no partner.

pictures.description: A sock, a marker, and a pair of drawn eyes.
pictures.text: She drew paper eyes and asked Grandpa to help stick them to the sock.

pictures.description: The sock puppet next to a box stage.
pictures.text: A box became a stage. The sock popped up to say hello.

pictures.description: An audience of a child and teddy in front of the puppet.
pictures.text: Her brother brought Teddy to watch. The sock forgot what it was going to say.

pictures.description: A music note above the puppet and the children.
pictures.text: Amara made the sock sing instead. Teddy danced in her brother's lap.

pictures.description: The children clap after the puppet's performance.
pictures.text: The sock took a bow. Its best part had been the bit nobody planned.

pictures.description: A child and corn beside a bowl.
pictures.text: Remy thought the little dry kernels looked too small to be a snack.

pictures.description: A grown-up by a lidded pot with corn nearby.
pictures.text: Dad put some in a pot, covered it, and asked Remy to listen from the table.

pictures.description: A lidded pot with a burst shape above it.
pictures.text: One pop sounded, then another. Soon the sounds came too fast to count.

pictures.description: A grown-up puts out a bowl of popcorn.
pictures.text: Dad poured the cooled popcorn into a bowl. Every piece was bigger than a kernel.

pictures.description: Two children with separate snacks.
pictures.text: Remy ate a little popcorn while Dad gave his toddler sister soft strawberries.

pictures.description: The children near the popcorn as a film starts.
pictures.text: They settled down for their film. Remy whispered, “Pop, pop!” just before it started.

pictures.description: Owl near a tree in the bright daytime.
pictures.text: Owl had been awake all night. Now she wanted a quiet branch for a nap.

pictures.description: A singing bird near Owl.
pictures.text: A bird was practising a new song. Every verse was louder than the last.

pictures.description: A squirrel beside Owl with a nut below.
pictures.text: In another tree, Squirrel dropped nuts. They rattled down the bark.

pictures.description: A large leafy tree beside Owl.
pictures.text: Owl found a tree with thick leaves. They made a soft swishing sound.

pictures.description: A sleepy sign above Owl and the tree.
pictures.text: The leaves swished so gently that Owl fell asleep right away.

pictures.description: Owl awake by the tree at night.
pictures.text: When the moon rose, Owl stretched her wings. Now it was her turn to make a little noise.

pictures.description: A boy with a toy car beside a muddy patch.
pictures.text: Hugo drove his toy car through a patch of mud.

pictures.description: The toy car sits near a bucket.
pictures.text: The wheels wouldn't turn. Mud had filled the spaces around them.

pictures.description: A sponge beside the car and the bucket.
pictures.text: Hugo dipped a sponge into water and slid it over the roof.

pictures.description: The toy car between a sponge and splashing water.
pictures.text: He rinsed the wheels until they spun again.

pictures.description: The car rests on a cloth in the sunshine.
pictures.text: While the car dried on a cloth, Hugo drew a new road.

pictures.description: The clean toy car beside a clear road.
pictures.text: He drove around the mud this time. One little puddle was too tempting to pass.

pictures.description: A child beside a paper crown.
pictures.text: Mila made a paper crown for their rainy-day play.

pictures.description: Two children and one crown.
pictures.text: Arlo wanted to wear it too. They both reached for it.

pictures.description: A torn crown between the two children.
pictures.text: The paper tore. Both children were quiet for a moment.

pictures.description: Paper and a marker sit between Mila and Arlo.
pictures.text: “We can fix it together,” said Arlo. They drew two crowns on a fresh sheet.

pictures.description: One crown above each of the children.
pictures.text: Mila made Arlo's taller. Arlo made Mila's covered in spots.

pictures.description: A teddy bear with a little crown between the children.
pictures.text: There was enough paper left for Teddy. His crown slipped right over his ears.

pictures.description: A girl with a torch beside a grown-up.
pictures.text: Nell and Mum shone a torch onto a bare wall.

pictures.description: A hand is held in the torchlight.
pictures.text: Nell put her hand in the light. A dark shape appeared on the wall.

pictures.description: Two raised fingers and the shape of a rabbit.
pictures.text: She held up two fingers. The shape looked a little like a rabbit's ears.

pictures.description: A large rabbit shape high above Nell.
pictures.text: She moved her hand nearer the torch. The rabbit grew big.

pictures.description: A small rabbit shape low on the wall.
pictures.text: She moved it back toward the wall. The rabbit shrank again.

pictures.description: A rabbit and a bird shape above two people.
pictures.text: Mum made a bird shadow. Nell gave it a small rabbit to talk to.

pictures.description: A boy finds two differently shaped leaves.
pictures.text: Tobi picked up a few big fallen leaves from the lawn.

pictures.description: A child and grown-up with leaves and yarn.
pictures.text: Dad helped him put the leaves on yarn to make a necklace for Teddy.

pictures.description: The bear beside the long loop of leafy yarn.
pictures.text: The loop was so long that it reached Teddy's toes.

pictures.description: A ruler beside the yarn and Teddy.
pictures.text: Tobi measured a shorter piece against Teddy's shoulders.

pictures.description: Teddy next to a shorter row of leaves.
pictures.text: The next one sat high on Teddy's chest. He looked ready for a walk in the woods.

pictures.description: Leaves hang up near a window.
pictures.text: They hung the long necklace by the window. Now the leaves could dance when the window opened.

pictures.description: A child and a grown-up with a mixing bowl.
pictures.text: Etta helped Grandma mix dough for rolls.

pictures.description: A ball of dough between the two cooks.
pictures.text: Grandma showed her how to roll a small piece into a ball.

pictures.description: Two little balls of dough beside the bowl.
pictures.text: Etta pressed two pieces together. Her roll looked a little like a cloud.

pictures.description: Freshly baked bread with a sign of warmth above it.
pictures.text: After baking, the two pieces had stuck together for good.

pictures.description: Etta and another child beside bread.
pictures.text: Once it cooled, Etta pulled her roll apart and gave her brother a piece.

pictures.description: The children and a plate with one last bit of bread.
pictures.text: It tasted like any other roll. The soft middle between the two bumps was best.

pictures.description: A frog and a hanging drop of water.
pictures.text: Frog heard a drip and woke up on a lily pad.

pictures.description: A drop falls off a leaf beside Frog.
pictures.text: A drop fell off a leaf and made a ring in the pond.

pictures.description: A duck splashes past Frog.
pictures.text: Duck paddled by. Her big rings met the tiny rings.

pictures.description: Frog and Duck under a raincloud.
pictures.text: Then rain started. Rings appeared everywhere, too many to follow.

pictures.description: Frog and Duck by a leaf on the bank.
pictures.text: Frog jumped under a leaf at the edge. Duck stayed in the shower.

pictures.description: Frog and Duck return to a sunny lily pad.
pictures.text: When the rain stopped, Frog jumped back to his pad. One last drop fell, and he heard it.

pictures.description: A child stands beside a statue in cold weather.
pictures.text: Ash passed a stone statue on the way to the shop. Its shoulders were white with frost.

pictures.description: Ash holds a scarf near the statue.
pictures.text: “It looks cold,” he said, holding up his scarf.

pictures.description: A grown-up talks to Ash near his scarf.
pictures.text: Dad said stone didn't feel cold the way Ash's ears did.

pictures.description: Ash with a scarf and another child.
pictures.text: Around the corner his cousin was waiting with bare ears and cold hands.

pictures.description: The scarf near the cousin's shoulders.
pictures.text: Ash lent her his spare scarf. She tied it in a big knot under her chin.

pictures.description: The children pass the statue as the sun comes out.
pictures.text: They waved to the statue on the way back. It still wore its coat of frost.

pictures.description: A girl finds a feather near a tree.
pictures.text: Wren spotted a feather lying on the path.

pictures.description: A feather lifts away from the path.
pictures.text: Before she could point it out to Grandpa, a breeze picked it up.

pictures.description: A child and a grown-up watch a flying feather.
pictures.text: They followed slowly. The feather floated over the grass.

pictures.description: The feather catches on some leaves.
pictures.text: It caught low on a bush, with its soft end sticking out.

pictures.description: The feather lifts again between Wren and Grandpa.
pictures.text: Another breeze pulled it free. This time they stayed still to watch.

pictures.description: A bird passes high near the drifting feather.
pictures.text: A bird flew past while the feather floated down. “One has wings,” said Wren. “One has the wind.”

pictures.description: A child beside a book and a little gift box.
pictures.text: Idris wanted to wrap a book for his sister. His gift box was too short.

pictures.description: A large book and a sheet of paper near Idris.
pictures.text: He spread a scrap of paper on the floor. That was too short as well.

pictures.description: There are now two scraps of paper by the book.
pictures.text: He matched two scraps at their edges. Together they reached past the book.

pictures.description: A painted pattern next to the book and paper.
pictures.text: He made a trail of painted dots across both scraps.

pictures.description: Idris presents a wrapped gift to his sister.
pictures.text: His sister followed the dots with her finger before opening the present.

pictures.description: The children with the book and the opened wrapping.
pictures.text: They saved the paper as a bookmark. The dots could wait inside the story.

pictures.description: A child and grown-up beside a rounded stone.
pictures.text: Cass and Gran found a round stone and a flatter one.

pictures.description: A stone rests on a small slope.
pictures.text: They let the round stone go on a gentle, empty slope. It rolled straight down.

pictures.description: A flat stone stays on the little slope.
pictures.text: From the same spot the flat stone hardly moved.

pictures.description: A turning arrow above the flat stone and two people.
pictures.text: Gran asked what would happen if they stood it on its edge.

pictures.description: The flat stone stops part way down the hill.
pictures.text: It wobbled down a little way and fell flat again.

pictures.description: Cass and Gran study the two stones side by side.
pictures.text: Cass left the stones together by the path. “Round or flat?” she asked on the way past the next day.

pictures.description: A child next to a pot and green leaves.
pictures.text: Ella's cousin could never find the mint in the garden.

pictures.description: Ella draws with paper and a crayon.
pictures.text: Ella drew their door, the path, and a big circle for the mint pot.

pictures.description: Ella and her cousin look at the drawing outdoors.
pictures.text: Her cousin followed the map and stopped at a pot by the gate.

pictures.description: Both children with a pot and a question mark.
pictures.text: It wasn't the mint. Ella's circle looked like every other pot.

pictures.description: Ella adds a green leaf to her drawing.
pictures.text: She added a green leaf and drew a stripy mat beside the right pot.

pictures.description: Both children have reached the mint.
pictures.text: Her cousin found the right pot. They rubbed one leaf and smelled mint on their fingers.

pictures.description: A child and grown-up beside a bowl.
pictures.text: Ari was setting the table. He put out one bowl for himself.

pictures.description: Two bowls are set out side by side.
pictures.text: Dad said he was eating too. Ari fetched a second bowl.

pictures.description: A girl arrives next to three bowls.
pictures.text: His sister came in, so Ari put out a third bowl.

pictures.description: One spoon and a bowl near the two children.
pictures.text: There was only one spoon on the table. His sister pointed to the empty places.

pictures.description: There are three spoons across the table.
pictures.text: Ari fetched two more spoons and laid one beside each bowl.

pictures.description: Three people at the table with their bowls.
pictures.text: They counted three bowls, three spoons, and three people ready for soup.

pictures.description: A girl has a cart beside a pot.
pictures.text: Miri wanted to take a big pot to the far end of the garden.

pictures.description: A grown-up helps move the pot onto the cart.
pictures.text: Dad helped her lift it into a little wagon. Miri pulled.

pictures.description: One of the wagon's wheels is close to a stone.
pictures.text: A wheel stopped against a stone. The wagon wouldn't go any farther.

pictures.description: The stone now sits beside the wagon.
pictures.text: Dad steadied the wagon while Miri moved the stone out of the way.

pictures.description: The wagon has reached a sunny patch by a flower.
pictures.text: The wagon rolled all the way to the sunny part of the garden.

pictures.description: The pot stands by the flower with the wagon empty.
pictures.text: They set the pot beside a sunflower. Miri took the empty wagon back for a rest.

pictures.description: A child and grown-up look up at a bright point.
pictures.text: Niko and Gran looked out at the night sky.

pictures.description: A light blinks to one side of the sky.
pictures.text: Niko spotted one light that blinked on and off.

pictures.description: A flashing light is now across from a bright star.
pictures.text: A little later the light was in a different place. The other lights hardly seemed to move.

pictures.description: A plane crosses the night sky.
pictures.text: Gran said a plane could look like one small light from far away.

pictures.description: Two steady stars visible above them.
pictures.text: The blinking light went away. Niko picked two steady stars to draw.

pictures.description: Niko draws the night sky in a notebook.
pictures.text: In his notebook he drew two dots and a line, so he could find the same patch tomorrow.

pictures.description: A child and grown-up beside a cardboard box.
pictures.text: Zuri got out an empty box while Dad sorted the recycling.

pictures.description: A toy car is held above the box.
pictures.text: She turned it over and made it a garage.

pictures.description: A boat above the box.
pictures.text: She turned it back and made it a boat for all her teddies.

pictures.description: Another child arrives with a teddy.
pictures.text: Her brother wanted to make a bed. They couldn't make all three things at once.

pictures.description: The two children make the box into a little bed.
pictures.text: They gave the boat one last trip, then laid a folded cloth in it for a bed.

pictures.description: The toys settle in the box for sleep.
pictures.text: The teddies fell asleep after their long day. The box was tired too.

pictures.description: A boy indoors by a window with a sound mark.
pictures.text: Ollie heard a small tap while he was drawing.

pictures.description: Ollie and a cat beside the door.
pictures.text: He checked the door. The cat sat there quietly.

pictures.description: Ollie checks the tap in the kitchen.
pictures.text: He checked the kitchen tap. The sink was dry.

pictures.description: Rain near the window beside Ollie.
pictures.text: A raindrop ran down the window. Then another one followed.

pictures.description: Ollie and a grown-up near the roof in the rain.
pictures.text: Dad showed him how drops from the tree fell onto the low roof.

pictures.description: Ollie draws beside a window in the rain.
pictures.text: Ollie finished his picture to the sound of taps. He added the tree to the corner.

pictures.description: Cat sits by a window in the sun.
pictures.text: Cat found a patch of morning sun beside the window.

pictures.description: Cat and a sofa sit near the window.
pictures.text: Later the warm patch reached the sofa. Cat moved with it.

pictures.description: Cat and a warm patch near the floor.
pictures.text: The patch slid onto the rug. Cat climbed down for a second nap.

pictures.description: Cat looks towards a window under a cloud.
pictures.text: A cloud covered the sun. The bright patch was gone.

pictures.description: A girl puts a soft cloth in a basket beside Cat.
pictures.text: Sera tucked a spare towel into a basket away from the draught.

pictures.description: Cat rests in the basket as the sun returns.
pictures.text: The sun came back, but Cat stayed in the basket. It was the warmest spot she knew.

pictures.description: A child and grown-up beside a sunflower.
pictures.text: Before bed, June and Mum walked out to say goodnight to the garden.

pictures.description: A bee is still near the sunflower.
pictures.text: They said goodnight to the sunflower. A bee was making one last visit.

pictures.description: A snail sits near the leaves beside June.
pictures.text: They said goodnight to a snail. It was just beginning to come out.

pictures.description: A bat passes above the people in the dusk.
pictures.text: A bat flew over the fence. Mum said some animals were only just waking up.

pictures.description: The child and grown-up walk back to their house.
pictures.text: June waved to everything, even the things she couldn't see.

pictures.description: A child ready for bed while the moon is outside.
pictures.text: “Good morning, bat,” she whispered from bed. “Goodnight, me.”
